avatar.hint: Click your avatar to randomize it

daily.heading: Daily challenge
daily.hint: One chain a day, the same for everyone. No time limit per turn.

createRoom.heading: Create room
createRoom.hint: You'll be able to adjust the turn time, vote time, and maximum number of turns once inside the room.

howToPlay.heading: How to play?
howToPlay.hint: Each player says a word related to the previous one, getting closer to the target word.

share.heading: Share with friends
share.hint: Enjoying it? Invite your friends to play a game.
share.text: Do you dare play PALINKO with me? 🔗🧠 Let's chain some words! 🎮 {url}

feedback.heading: Feedback & support
feedback.hint: Got suggestions or found a bug? Message me on LinkedIn, and if you enjoyed the project, support it with a star on GitHub!
